title: A pool-share trustline removed by an AllowTrust or SetTrustLineFlags revocation gets no trustline_removed effect

target.versions_affected: v30.0.1 and main 01ba44a (internal/ingest/processors/ is the same in both; range not established)

severity_basis: EffectTrustlineRemoved is written only by addChangeTrustEffects, which runs for ChangeTrust only; addAllowTrustEffects and addSetTrustLineFlagsEffects write the flag effects and liquidity_pool_revoked and never look at the trustlines the operation removes, so when a revocation makes stellar-core redeem the trustor's pool shares and remove the pool-share trustline (CAP-38), the account's effects show the trustline as created and never removed. The account's balances are right; only the effects history misses the row.

entries.expected: a trustline_removed effect for the trustor's pool-share trustline, with asset_type liquidity_pool_shares and the pool's liquidity_pool_id, as a ChangeTrust removal of the same trustline gets
entries.observed: Not run by the kit against Horizon (Horizon has no replay adapter in this kit). By hand on the four local stellar-core variants of this entry (protocols 28 and 30, testnet and pubnet passphrases): the SetTrustLineFlags revocation removes one pool-share trustline and Horizon writes no trustline_removed. The AllowTrust case is from pubnet ledgers, not from this entry: at v30.0.1, ledger 50914934, transaction 6b1d2cb8… removes 1 pool-share trustline and gets 0 trustline_removed; ledger 55568683, transaction cfe5afa4… removes 9 and gets 0.

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs, with the reproduction in the upstream issue; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's test (internal/ingest/processors/revoked_pool_share_trustline_test.go) at v30.0.1 on pubnet ledger 50914934 from the public data lake fails: expected 1 trustline_removed, actual 0; the same on main 01ba44a (git diff v30.0.1 main -- internal/ingest/processors/ is empty). On pubnet ledger 55568683, transaction cfe5afa41074ab428e2f4440f7b06895a90dacd5e2cb1aa2596fd234e3946f6c, four AllowTrust operations remove 9 pool-share trustlines and no trustline_removed is written.
evidence.expected_basis: CAP-38 (https://github.com/stellar/stellar-protocol/blob/master/core/cap-0038.md): revoking authorization redeems the holder's pool shares into claimable balances and removes the pool-share trustline; the operation meta shows the trustline LEDGER_ENTRY_REMOVED, and Horizon writes trustline_removed when a ChangeTrust with limit 0 removes the same trustline.

reproduction.method: The run the issue reports, made on v30.0.1 and main 01ba44a before filing on 2026-11-19: the test finds 1 pool-share trustline removed in the operation meta and 0 trustline_removed effects.

queries: stellar/stellar-horizon: every issue and pull request title, open and closed
stellar/go: issues and pull requests about Horizon effects of pool-share trustlines

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-19: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-19 as https://github.com/stellar/stellar-horizon/issues/267; this record restates the public issue.
